ram:1899.comment: The call to FUN_CODE_0003 passes a generic pointer (R3:R2:R1) set to NULL: the firmware loads R3=0, R2=0, R1=0, not three byte arguments in R7/R5/R3. FUN_CODE_0f3f is ?C?CLDPTR (load a char through a generic pointer in R3:R2:R1). With the parameter declared as a generic pointer and a constant NULL argument, Keil emits MOV R3,#0 / MOV R2,#0 / MOV R1,#0 directly instead of CLR A followed by register moves.
ram:1899.name: FUN_CODE_1899

ram:18d6.comment: Read-modify-write sequence on an xdata register: an OR-store followed by a fresh MOVX A,@DPTR read and an AND-store. The variable must be declared volatile so that Keil re-reads it after the OR-store instead of keeping the value in A.
ram:18d6.name: FUN_CODE_18d6
